chunks: There is no harm in your eating together or separately.
But when you enter the houses, salute the inmates with a greeting in the name of God, invoking blessings and good health.
That is how God explains things to you clearly so that you may understand.
They alone are true believers who believe in God and His Apostle,
and when they are with him on a matter of common concern, do not depart without obtaining his leave.
Surely those who ask leave of you are the ones who believe in God and His Apostle.
Therefore when they ask leave of you for personal business give leave to those you please, and seek God's forgiveness for them.
Surely God is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What are the etiquettes of eating and entering homes for believers according to this text?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the protocol of obedience to the Prophet (and by extension, the Imams) during collective endeavors, where seeking permission signifies respect for authority and unity. It underscores that true faith is manifested not just in belief, but in adhering to the etiquette of consultation and permission in both public and private spheres, reflecting the divine mercy granted to those who maintain this discipline.
